data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Idempotency is the extensional property f(f(x))=f(x) \u2014 the observable result of applying an operation n\u22651 times equals applying it once. Safety is the intensional property that an operation's internal execution produces no harmful side effects, regardless of how many times it runs. For an append-only event log surviving at-least-once delivery, idempotency is the property the log must require: a duplicate write must leave the log in the same state as a single write. Safety alone is insufficient because a 'safe' operation (one that causes no harm) could still append distinct duplicate events \u2014 e.g., a writer that generates a fresh event ID on each call is 'safe' (no corruption, no crash) but not idempotent, and its duplicates would break deterministic replay.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If 'safety' is defined in published literature to include 'no observable additional effect on retry,' then safety subsumes idempotency and this claim collapses.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the log deduplicates events by writer-assigned deterministic keys before replay, then a non-idempotent writer could still yield deterministic replay, weakening the necessity of idempotency.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If replay is defined to occur only on the final log state (not on intermediate states), then intermediate corruption from a non-safe but idempotent operation would be invisible, and safety would be unnecessary.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"At-least-once delivery means the transport may redeliver a writer's request. The log, being append-only, sees a sequence of write attempts. If the writer's operation is idempotent, then append(event) followed by append(event) yields the same log as append(event) \u2014 the duplicate is absorbed. If the writer is merely 'safe' (no harmful side effects) but not idempotent, duplicates produce a longer log, and replay diverges from single-delivery replay. The counterexample is a safe non-idempotent writer: one that timestamps each append with wall-clock time. No harm occurs, but the log differs across retry counts, breaking determinism.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
